title: Drone law dataset
description: A dataset of static drone rules for developers. Live TFRs, airspace class, stadium schedules, and daylight times are supplied separately.

schema_version.description: Dataset format version. Check this before parsing.

updated.description: Date the dataset was last updated.

license.description: License for the original dataset content.

notes.description: Caveats that apply to the whole dataset.

jurisdictions.description: Places referenced by rules. Use the standard code where one exists.

rules.description: Static rules. Filter these by location and operation type.

ruleId.description: Stable lowercase identifier. Do not reuse it for a different rule.

jurisdictionId.description: Standard code where one exists: ISO 3166-1 country, ISO 3166-2 state, FIPS county, or FIPS place. Otherwise a lowercase local slug.

jurisdiction.description: A place where a rule applies.

name.description: Display name, such as City of Columbus or Ohio.

source.description: Official source for the rule. Use label as the link text.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdiction IDs where the rule applies. Each ID must exist in the top-level jurisdictions array.

category.description: UI grouping. airspace covers altitude and controlled airspace; tfr covers temporary flight restrictions; stadium covers stadium events; state covers state-wide rules; local covers city, county, and park-district rules.

type.description: restriction renders as a warning; allowance renders as allowed; notice renders as information.

applies_to.description: Operation type. all applies to any UAS operation; part-107 applies to Part 107 operations; recreational applies only to recreational operations.

scope.description: Display text for where or when the rule applies. Not used for spatial filtering; use jurisdictions for matching.

title.description: Short heading for a card or list item.

message.description: Plain-language explanation of the rule, including the practical limit, exception, or action.

checked_on.description: Date the source was last checked.
